about:
Baseline Contract Sewing operates from a manufacturing facility in Lafayette, Colorado. The company was founded in 1989 as Sportwaves Unlimited by Herbert Riehl and LeeAnn Staples, initially producing athletic bags for baseball, softball, and soccer. Within a year, the partners expanded into contract manufacturing, sewing, and print production. Herbert Riehl remains the founder and guiding force behind the business.

The shop provides full-service cut-and-sew manufacturing, including stack cutting, web cutting, die cutting, and hot and cold webbing and Velcro cutting. Precision sewing handles small runs through large-scale production. In-house design and prototyping cover pattern work, technical design, material sourcing, and design optimization. Printing and branding capabilities span DTF (Direct-to-Film), screen printing, dye-sublimation, heat-press, and vinyl applications. The facility also performs inspection, quality control, packaging, fulfillment, and hardware installation such as snaps, grommets, rivets, and eyelets.

Baseline serves clients ranging from local Colorado startups to nationwide brands. Its industry experience includes medical and technical textiles, outdoor gear—such as a custom backpack developed for an outdoor gear startup—and athletic bags. The company emphasizes adaptability across a wide variety of products and industries.

The company cites its 35-plus years of operation, local roots, and a dedicated team as foundations of its reliability. It highlights made-in-Colorado, made-in-USA production, fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and a rigorous multi-point inspection process. Clients have stayed for decades, attributing loyalty to transparent processes and a policy of never cutting corners.
